Shri Gajendra Parashar - Panel Lawyer for respondents/St
 Order

This petition under Article 226 of Constitution of India has been filed seeking following relief(s):-
"(I) To issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent no.3 to pay the compensation of award some of Rs.24,02,510/- with the interest of 18% till realization of payment.
(II) To issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents to take suitable and effective action of the representation preferred by the petitioner for payment of award.
(III) To issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the officials respondent to take suitable and effective action against the person concerned who involve in the forgery, who has committed fraud for releasing and receiving the amount some of Rs.24,02,540/- of petitioner.

(IV) Any other relief/direction/prod which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case, may also kindly be granted to the petitioner along with cost of entire litigation."

2024:MPHC-JBP:54677 2 WP-32787-2024 has been paid to respondent No.7.

It is submitted that petitioner had filed an application before SDO for payment of compensation amount to the petitioner, however fairly conceded that as per provisions of Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, an application should have been filed before Collector, therefore, counsel for petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this petition with liberty to file a properly constituted application under Section 64 of Act, 2013 before the competent authority.
